title: Active Learning for Electronic Structure
short_description: Given a large body of DFT electronic-structure data, design an active-learning method that minimizes prediction error on a held-out set under a fixed labeling budget.
scientific_value: Labeling electronic-structure data with first-principles calculations is expensive. A principled active-learning strategy that selects which structures to label next — under a hard budget — directly reduces the cost of building accurate surrogate models, a bottleneck across computational materials science and chemistry.
scientific_context: Density functional theory (DFT) is the workhorse of computational materials discovery, but each calculation carries real compute cost. Machine-learned surrogates can amortize that cost, yet their accuracy depends heavily on which training points are labeled. This task measures whether an agent can design and execute a data-selection strategy that reasons about model uncertainty, chemical diversity and budget allocation — a genuine research workflow, not a textbook exercise.
task_description: The agent receives a large pool of unlabeled candidate structures, a small seed set of labeled DFT electronic-structure data, and a fixed labeling budget. It must design and implement an active-learning loop — selection strategy, surrogate model, and stopping/allocation logic — that chooses which structures to label. Success is measured by the final surrogate model's prediction error on a hidden held-out set.
environment: Containerized scientific Python environment with access to the labeled/unlabeled data pools and a labeling oracle that enforces the budget.
input_artifacts: Seed set of labeled DFT data
expected_output: A trained surrogate model plus the log of labeling decisions, evaluated against the hidden held-out set.
evaluation_method: Programmatic evaluation: the submitted model is scored on a hidden held-out set after the labeling budget is exhausted.
primary_metric: Held-out prediction error (MAE) under a fixed labeling budget
verification_method: Deterministic scoring script against a hidden held-out set; labeling budget enforced by the environment oracle, making budget circumvention detectable.
anti_cheating_notes: The held-out set is never exposed to the agent. The labeling oracle is the only path to ground-truth labels and hard-enforces the budget. Data provenance is controlled to limit contamination from public training corpora.
provenance_note: Candidate pilot task. Proposed by the AI4S-Benchmark founding group; currently in scientific review. Final specification, difficulty calibration and budgets will be fixed during the Task PR stage.
